mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_condition(model, tab_type, content, belong_man, belong_man_id, create_man_id, create_man) VALUES (#{model}, #{tabType}, #{content}, #{belongMan}, #{belongManId}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: SELECT id, model, tab_type, content, belong_man, belong_man_id FROM search_condition WHERE belong_man_id = #{belongManId} AND model = #{model} AND tab_type = #{tabType} AND is_deleted = false
